title: Effective descent and morphism gluing for sheaves of sets along a covering
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with all fibre products, and let $\{U_a\to U\}_{a\in A}$ be a covering. Work in a universe containing the objects, arrows and index set $A$, closed under the products below [def-weil-size-convention]. For an object $V\to U$, restriction to the slice site $\mathcal C/V$ means $F|_V(W\to V)=F(W\to V\to U)$ for a sheaf on $\mathcal C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For each $a$ let $F_a$ be a sheaf of sets on $\mathcal C/U_a$ and let $\phi_{ab}:F_a|_{U_a\times_UU_b}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_b|_{U_a\times_UU_b}$ be isomorphisms, including when $a=b$. Suppose $\phi_{ac}=\phi_{bc}\circ\phi_{ab}$ after restriction to each triple fibre product. There is a sheaf of sets $F$ on $\mathcal C/U$ and isomorphisms $e_a:F|_{U_a}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_a$ with $e_b=\phi_{ab}\circ e_a$ on each double fibre product. Moreover, for sheaves of sets $P,Q$ on $\mathcal C/U$, every family of maps $f_a:P|_{U_a}\to Q|_{U_a}$ agreeing on the double fibre products is the restriction of a unique map $f:P\to Q$.

proof.text: Give the covering precoverage associated to J its site structure: identity coverings are inherited, composition is J.toPretopology.transitive, and covering base changes are the chosen pullbacks, using Sieve.ofArrows_eq_pullback_of_isPullback and pullback stability. The topology generated by this precoverage is J: one inclusion is toGrothendieck_toPrecoverage_le and the other follows by applying generate_mem_toGrothendieck to each covering sieve. Apply [lem-pe-site-sheaf-gluing] to this precoverage and rewrite its generated topology as J. This gives the effective descent clause with the required descent-data isomorphism.

proof.text: For sheaves M,N on the slice at U, identify Mathlib sheafHom' M N with the morphism presheaf of J.pseudofunctorOver. At T over U, apply Sheaf.homEquiv, then precomposition along T.iteratedSliceBackward.op, then Sheaf.homEquiv.symm. Precomposition is fully faithful since iteratedSliceBackward is the inverse in the iterated-slice equivalence. Its composite with the forgetful functors is Over.map T.hom, so the endpoints are the required restrictions. Check naturality componentwise, using the pseudofunctor composition constraints and the naturality of the given sheaf morphism. Mathlib sheafHom has the sheaf property; transfer it across this natural isomorphism with Presheaf.isSheaf_of_iso_iff. This gives the IsPrestack structure.

Nothing is weakened and no hypothesis is added. Step 1: the component sheaves follow from 00VH(iii) base change in def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology(1). Step 3: restricting the (a,a,a) cocycle to the diagonal gives alpha=alpha^2, so the diagonal pullback of phi_aa is the identity; nothing is claimed off the diagonal. Steps 4-5: I checked the graph maps d_a and (pr_W, W->U_a, pr_b), the cocycle on W_bc, both inverse identities and naturality. Step 6: pulling back along the graph into W_ab gives phi_ab e_a = e_b. Steps 7-8: I checked amalgamation on the base-changed cover, naturality by separatedness, the restriction identity f_W(s)=d_a^*f_a(r_a^*s)=f_a(s), and uniqueness. I tested an empty cover (everything is terminal and the result holds), an identity cover, a non-mono singleton cover with phi_aa not the identity off the diagonal, repeated members and empty section sets.
